title: Infos pratiques 2026 — start waves and drop bags (search cache)
claims: The 2026 CCC start waves were 09:00 for Top Elites, Elites and CCC1, 09:15 for CCC2 and 09:30 for CCC3.
The 2026 OCC start waves were 08:15 for Top Elites, Elites and OCC1, 08:30 for OCC2, 08:45 for OCC3 and 09:00 for OCC4.
At CCC, each runner can deposit one drop bag, collect it at Champex-Lac and then at the finish.
At OCC, each runner can deposit one drop bag and collect it at the finish.
Only the organiser's drop bags are transported; poles and valuables must not be placed in them, and bags must be collected within two hours of finishing.
